summary: Occupying an enviable position within the heart of the highly sought-after village of Heighington, this charming double-fronted semi-detached home enjoys delightful views overlooking the picturesque village church and offers an abundance of character, generous living accommodation and beautifully established gardens
description:
Offered to the market with the advantage of no onward chain, the property presents an exciting opportunity for a wide range of purchasers to create a truly wonderful family home, with scope for cosmetic updating to suit individual tastes and requirements. Situated in one of County Durham's most desirable villages, Church View enjoys an idyllic setting surrounded by period homes and attractive village architecture. Heighington offers an excellent range of everyday amenities, including a well-regarded primary school, village shops, traditional public houses, cafés and a welcoming community atmosphere. The neighbouring towns of Newton Aycliffe and Darlington provide an extensive selection of shopping, leisure and educational facilities, whilst excellent transport links via the A1(M), A68 and nearby railway stations make the location ideal for commuters travelling throughout the region. Internally, the property offers deceptively spacious and versatile accommodation arranged over two floors. A welcoming entrance hallway leads to a generously proportioned lounge and dining room, a ground floor WC and a superb open-plan kitchen/family room, creating the perfect hub for everyday family life and entertaining. Adding to the property's unique appeal, double doors from the family room open into an impressive mezzanine-style bedroom, providing flexible accommodation that could equally lend itself to a guest suite, home office or hobby room. To the first floor are three further well-proportioned double bedrooms, all served by a spacious family bathroom, ensuring the property is ideally suited to growing families or those seeking versatile living accommodation. Externally, the property is equally as impressive. To the front, a charming forecourt garden is enclosed by traditional stone walls, mature hedging and established shrubbery, creating an attractive approach to the home. The rear garden is a true highlight, enjoying a wonderfully private, cottage-style setting. Beautifully enclosed by stone walls, the tiered garden features paved patio seating areas, generous lawned sections and an abundance of mature trees, colourful planting, shrubs and established borders, creating a peaceful outdoor sanctuary that can be enjoyed throughout the seasons. Offering an abundance of charm, character and versatility in one of the area's most desirable village locations, this delightful home presents an exceptional opportunity to modernise and personalise a substantial family property whilst retaining its timeless appeal. With its picturesque outlook across the village church, generous accommodation, enchanting gardens and the added benefit of no onward chain, early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this unique home has to offer.

ENTRANCE

Accessed via an attractive composite entrance door with decorative glazed inserts allowing for natural lighting.

ENTRANCE HALL The welcoming entrance hallway immediately sets the tone for this charming village home. Natural light filters through the inset glazing, creating a bright and inviting first impression whilst complementing the property's character and warmth. Finished with attractive wood flooring, the hallway offers a practical under-stair storage cupboard, ideal for everyday household essentials, and provides staircase access to the first floor. Serving as the central hub of the home, this spacious and welcoming entrance creates an immediate sense of charm and character that continues throughout the property.

LOUNGE The lounge is a beautifully proportioned and characterful reception room, offering a warm and inviting space in which to relax and unwind. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows an abundance of natural light to fill the room, enhancing its bright and welcoming atmosphere whilst complementing the property's charming village setting. A feature fireplace with a decorative surround, tiled inset and matching hearth provides an attractive focal point, adding to the room's traditional appeal. Attractive wood flooring flows throughout, whilst bespoke inset shelving to the alcoves offers both practical storage and display space, further enhancing the character of the room. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, completing this elegant and inviting living space.

DINING ROOM The dining room is a wonderfully characterful second reception room, offering an ideal space for both formal dining and everyday family living. Rich in charm and period features, the room enjoys an inviting atmosphere, perfectly reflecting the cottage-style appeal of this delightful village home. A striking granite fireplace with a slate hearth houses an inset log-burning stove, creating a stunning focal point and a cosy setting during the colder months. Attractive exposed ceiling beams further enhance the room's character, whilst the continuation of the wood flooring adds warmth and complements the traditional aesthetic. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows plenty of natural light to fill the room, with a radiator providing year-round comfort. Beautifully proportioned and full of charm, this elegant reception room offers the perfect setting for entertaining guests or enjoying relaxed family meals, seamlessly blending period character with everyday practicality.

OPEN PLAN KITCHEN / FAMILY ROOM Undoubtedly the heart of this charming home, the impressive open-plan kitchen/family room provides a superb living and entertaining space, beautifully combining character with modern-day practicality. Generously proportioned and flooded with natural light, this exceptional room has been thoughtfully designed to accommodate both everyday family life and social occasions, with an effortless connection to the delightful rear garden. The kitchen is fitted with an extensive range of quality base and wall units, complemented by elegant marble work surfaces and coordinating splashbacks, creating a stylish yet highly functional workspace. An inset sink unit with drainer is perfectly positioned within the work surface, whilst integrated appliances include a double oven with hob and a stainless steel chimney-style extractor over, together with an integrated dishwasher, fridge and freezer. Attractive wood flooring flows throughout the kitchen, enhancing the warmth and character of the space. Opening seamlessly into the family area, this wonderfully versatile room offers an abundance of space for comfortable seating, making it the true hub of the home. Three Velux roof windows, together with a double-glazed sash window, bathe the room in natural light, whilst inset ceiling spotlights create a welcoming ambience into the evening. French doors open directly onto the rear garden, providing an excellent extension of the living space and creating the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor entertaining. A further composite door offers additional access to the garden, whilst elegant double doors lead through to the unique mezzanine bedroom, adding to the flexibility and appeal of this exceptional family living space.

MEZZANINE GROUND FLOOR BEDROOM A truly unique and characterful addition to the home, the mezzanine bedroom offers a wonderfully versatile living space, beautifully blending original charm with contemporary design. Flooded with natural light, this impressive room enjoys a bright and airy atmosphere, creating a peaceful retreat that is unlike any other within the property. A striking feature stone chimney breast, complete with a log-burning stove, provides an eye-catching focal point and enhances the room's warm, cottage-style appeal. Double doors open directly onto the rear garden, creating a seamless connection with the outdoor space and allowing an abundance of natural light to pour into the room, whilst a radiator ensures year-round comfort. A beautifully crafted wooden staircase leads to the mezzanine level, where attractive wood flooring continues throughout. This elevated area offers a wealth of flexibility and could be utilised as a relaxing seating area, home office or study, providing the perfect place to work from home or unwind with a book. Whether retained as a unique bedroom suite or adapted to suit individual lifestyles, this exceptional space is a standout feature of the property, adding both charm and versatility to this delightful village home.

GROUND FLOOR SHOWER ROOM The ground floor shower room is conveniently located just off the annexe living room and is fitted with a modern three-piece suite comprising a walk-in shower cubicle, wash hand basin and WC. The room provides a practical and easily accessible showering facility, making it particularly well suited to the annexe accommodation.

UTILITY ROOM A practical and well-appointed utility room provides valuable additional workspace and storage, complementing the excellent family accommodation on offer. Fitted with a range of base and wall units, the room offers ample storage for household essentials whilst maintaining a neat and functional environment. There is plumbing for an automatic washing machine together with space for a tumble dryer, making it an ideal laundry area. Attractive wood flooring continues the quality finish found throughout the ground floor, whilst a UPVC-framed double-glazed window provides natural light and ventilation. A radiator ensures year-round comfort, and a door leads conveniently to the ground floor WC, enhancing the practicality of this well-designed home.

GROUND FLOOR WC Conveniently positioned off the utility room, the ground floor WC is fitted with a contemporary white suite comprising a low-level WC and wash hand basin. Finished with tiled walls, the room is both stylish and practical, complementing the quality and character found throughout the home. A useful built-in storage cupboard with a hanging rail provides excellent additional storage for coats and household essentials, whilst a wall-mounted heated towel rail adds warmth and comfort. This well-appointed cloakroom is a valuable addition to the ground floor accommodation, enhancing the practicality of this spacious family home.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing is a particularly attractive feature of the home, enjoying a wonderful sense of light and character. A striking large stained-glass window overlooks the beautiful rear garden, creating an eye-catching focal point whilst allowing natural light to flood the landing and enhancing the property's period charm. Providing access to all three double bedrooms and the family bathroom, the landing continues the spacious feel found throughout the home. There is also loft access via a pull-down ladder, offering useful additional storage potential. Beautifully presented and full of character, this impressive landing perfectly complements the charm and individuality of this delightful village home.

BEDROOM ONE The principal bedroom is an exceptionally spacious double room, enjoying generous proportions and a bright, airy atmosphere, making it a peaceful retreat at the end of the day. Beautifully presented and full of natural light, the room offers ample space to accommodate a comprehensive range of bedroom furniture without compromising on comfort or practicality. A window provides a pleasant outlook whilst allowing natural light to flood the room, enhancing its warm and inviting feel. A full range of built-in wardrobes offers excellent storage and hanging space, ensuring a sleek and uncluttered finish. Combining space, functionality and comfort, this impressive principal bedroom perfectly complements the charm and character found throughout this delightful village home.

BEDROOM TWO A further generously proportioned double bedroom, continuing the spacious accommodation found throughout this charming home. Beautifully bright and well presented, the room offers ample space for a range of bedroom furniture, making it an ideal guest bedroom, children's room or comfortable space for family members. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows plenty of natural light to flood the room, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere, whilst a radiator provides warmth and comfort throughout the year. Well balanced in size and full of potential, this attractive second bedroom perfectly complements the flexible and versatile accommodation offered by this delightful village property.

BEDROOM THREE Completing the bedroom accommodation is a further well-proportioned double bedroom, offering excellent versatility to suit a variety of lifestyles. Whether utilised as a generous guest bedroom, children's room, home office or hobby room, this spacious room provides ample flexibility for modern family living. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window fills the room with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere, whilst a radiator ensures year-round comfort. Continuing the generous proportions and character evident throughout the property, this attractive third double bedroom further enhances the appeal of this charming village home.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is exceptionally spacious, offering an abundance of floor space and beautifully complementing the generous proportions found throughout this charming home. Thoughtfully designed with both style and practicality in mind, the room provides a luxurious and relaxing setting for everyday family living. At the heart of the bathroom is an elegant freestanding bath, creating a striking focal point and the perfect place to unwind. In addition, a generous double shower cubicle with an inset mains-fed shower offers the convenience of a separate showering space. A wash hand basin and low-level WC complete the suite, with tasteful tiling to the splashback and vanity areas complementing the attractive part-panelled walls, enhancing the room's character and timeless appeal. Inset ceiling spotlights provide a contemporary finish, whilst two UPVC-framed double-glazed windows flood the room with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. A radiator ensures warmth and comfort throughout the year. Combining space, elegance and functionality, this beautifully appointed family bathroom perfectly completes the accommodation within this delightful village home.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property enjoys beautifully established gardens to both the front and rear, perfectly complementing the charm and character of this delightful village home. To the front, an attractive forecourt garden is enclosed by traditional stone walls and mature hedging, creating a welcoming approach and an excellent degree of privacy. The garden has been thoughtfully landscaped with a combination of paved and gravelled areas, enhanced by well-stocked borders planted with an array of established shrubs, providing year-round colour and interest. The rear garden is a true highlight of the property, offering a wonderfully private and tranquil outdoor retreat. Enclosed by attractive stone walls, the garden has been beautifully designed over a series of gently tiered levels, creating an enchanting cottage-style setting. A choice of paved seating areas provides the perfect spots for outdoor dining and entertaining, whilst generous lawned sections are interspersed with established trees, colourful planting, mature shrubs and an abundance of seasonal flora. Lovingly maintained and bursting with charm, this delightful garden enjoys a wonderfully peaceful atmosphere, offering a real cottage garden feel and providing the perfect place to relax and enjoy the changing seasons. A rare feature for a property of this style, the gardens truly enhance the overall appeal of this exceptional village home.
